question: Which of the following Indian festivals is celebrated to pay reverence to Lord Jagannath?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ratha Yatra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ratha Yatra is a Hindu festival associated with Lord Jagannath **held at Shri Kshetra Puri Dham in the state of Odisha, India.
 
• It is the oldest Ratha Yatra, whose descriptions can be found in** Brahma Purana, Padma Purana, and Skanda Purana and Kapila Samhita.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Losar also known as Tibetan New Year, is a festival in Tibetan Buddhism. The holiday is celebrated on various dates depending on location tradition.
 
• The Hemis Festival **marks the birth anniversary of Guru Padmasambhava and the victory of good over evil**. Also known as Tse-Chu, the event will be held in one of Ladakh's famous monasteries, Hemis Gompa. 
 
• Thrissur Pooram is **one of the biggest festivals in Kerala**. It is a Hindu temple festival held in various temples of the state, though the center of attraction is Vadakkunnathan temple.
